A bug-fix update to v1.1.0.

### Fixed

* **Books you mark as read now show as 100%.** "Mark as Read" on the Kindle doesn't change the reading progress it stores, so a finished book stayed at the page you stopped on (e.g. 73%). InkSights now reads the Kindle's read status too, and counts the book as finished.

### Downloads

* `inksights-1.1.1.zip`: the Kindle app
* `inksights-backup-calibre-1.1.1.zip`: the optional calibre backup plugin (unchanged apart from the version)

### Upgrading from v1.1.0

Copy the new `extensions` and `documents` folders over the old ones. Your reading log in `reading-stats/` is kept.
